rootCauses.emptyBoard: The AI returned a 1-segment lesson with a single write_latex action (the screenshot's 1/1). The board had nothing else to draw and the work zone hugged the top corner.
rootCauses.floatingBox: .board-object.state-highlighted painted a rounded background + inset border (a UI card look).
rootCauses.tinyMath: Board base font was 1rem with .math at 1.16em — small on a 1440px board.
rootCauses.cornerContent: .zone-work did not grow or centre; rows sat at the top of a tall empty board.
rootCauses.consoleBadge: The '5 Issues' badge came from the earlier broken dev bundle (ReferenceError during an intermediate edit); fresh sessions now report 0 console issues.

fixes.lessonQuality: Server: a mode='new' lesson with fewer than 2 segments is rejected into the repair pass (prompt still targets 3–5). Prompt: start with a short heading in top region, build across zones, and for any x–y relation add draw_axes + plot_graph (5–12 points) + intercept plot_points + explanation labels.
fixes.chalkEmphasis: state-highlighted is now a soft amber chalk glow (drop-shadow) — no background box, no inset border.
fixes.typography: board font clamp(1.08rem,1.3vw,1.5rem) × board-scale; .math 1.35em; labels 1em; bigger row gaps and padding.
fixes.composition: .zone-work flexes and centres its content in the reading band; graph layer max width 440px; larger board padding.
fixes.tests: core/routes/teaching fakes updated to realistic 3-segment lessons for the new validation.
